preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have an integer n representing the length of the permutation, which must be between 1 and 100,000.
The total sum of all n values across all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output -1; otherwise, output n distinct integers forming a permutation.

postconditions.expression: all((int(p[i]) + i)**0.5 == int((int(p[i]) + i)**0.5) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each index i, the value p[i] + i must be a perfect square.
The output must contain all integers from 0 to n-1 exactly once.
